# rixl_subscription (Resource)

Manages an organization billing subscription tier and Stripe payment plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_subscription" "enterprise" {
  org_id          = var.rixl_org_id
  stripe_price_id = "price_01h7abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stripe_price_id` (String)

### Optional

- `org_id` (String)
- `payment_method_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cancel_at_period_end` (Boolean)
- `currency` (String)
- `current_period_end` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `expiring_soon` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `plan_id` (String)
- `plan_name` (String)
- `plan_type` (String)
- `price` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `stripe_customer_id` (String)
- `stripe_subscription_id` (String)
- `trials_ending_soon` (Boolean)
